family: F-btrfs-lock-hold: btrfs root->inodes xa_lock held across shrinker scan (cond_resched_lock ineffective under PREEMPT_NONE)
root_cause: find_first_inode_to_shrink() (fs/btrfs/extent_map.c, extent-map shrinker) and btrfs_find_first_inode() hold root->inodes.xa_lock while scanning/skipping inodes and only release it via cond_resched_lock(), which under CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE drops the lock only at timeslice expiry (~2.8 ms); inode create (btrfs_add_inode_to_root -> xa_store) and evict paths spin on the lock. Amplifier: KVM guest without PV qspinlocks (unfair virt_spin_lock) lets one vCPU starve >22 s -> softlockup_panic.
fatal_mechanism: soft lockup in queued_spin_lock_slowpath (virt_spin_lock) from xa_store in btrfs_create_new_inode

fix_commits.subject: btrfs: always drop root->inodes lock before cond_resched()
fix_commits.author: Boris Burkov

equivalent_fix_criteria: Patch makes find_first_inode_to_shrink()/btrfs_find_first_inode() unconditionally drop root->inodes lock around cond_resched() (or otherwise bounds lock hold time in the scan). Enabling PV spinlocks alone = mitigation, not the fix.
